narrative.rotation_signal: Capital is rotating INTO payments (V/MA/AXP), mega-cap tech (GOOGL/AMZN/META/NFLX), and defensive staples/pharma (KO/PG/JNJ/ABBV) — a barbell accumulation pattern. Capital is rotating OUT OF semicap equipment (KLAC/LRCX), legacy semis (INTC), energy (XOM), and industrial gases (LIN), suggesting a defensive-growth tilt rather than pure risk-on.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: INTC, XOM, CSCO, and UNH all show maxed dark pool/block magnitude that could read bullish at the industry layer, but Top 50 flow direction (sub-3.0 scores) reframes those prints as distribution. KLAC/LRCX bearish read may diverge from broader semiconductor industry positioning if NVDA/AVA-led names carry the group.
